title: Vanishing at the end of a primitive sl2 string
statement: Let $L$ be a rational Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra] and $M$ a finite-dimensional rational representation, that is, a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q$-vector space with a linear map $\rho:L\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Q}(M)$ satisfying $\rho([x,y])=\rho(x)\rho(y)-\rho(y)\rho(x)$. Let $h,e,f\in L$ satisfy $h\ne0$, $[e,f]=h$, $[h,e]=2e$, and $[h,f]=-2f$. For $n\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}$ and $v\in M$ with $v\ne0$, $\rho(h)v=nv$, and $\rho(e)v=0$, one has $$\rho(f)^{n+1}v=0.$$ No finite-dimensionality of $L$ is assumed.
